prompt: Which limitations of LLM-as-a-judge did Zheng et al. (MT-Bench) examine?

options.text: Agreement with humans is below 50%, so judges are unusable.

explanation: The paper analyzes position, verbosity and self-enhancement biases and limited reasoning ability, and proposes mitigations. It also reports that strong judges such as GPT-4 reached over 80% agreement with humans, the same level as human-human agreement.

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena (Zheng et al.)
